     8	/-!
     9	# The rank-one evaluation zero-locus comparison
    10	
    11	The canonical inverse is cut out by the evaluation counit, while the existing divisor engine
    12	consumes the tied cocycle datum's local equations.  This file proves the section-level comparison
    13	between those two descriptions before any Noetherian or regularity hypothesis is introduced.
    14	
    15	For a tied local presentation, transporting a datum section through `module_iso.inv` commutes
    16	with restriction to every open.  Since every component of the sheaf isomorphism is injective,
    17	restriction vanishes on the module side exactly when it vanishes on the datum side.  Applying
    18	this to the canonical unit-lift through the evaluation counit identifies its restriction-
    19	vanishing predicate with that of `datumSection`.  The final theorem specializes the comparison
    20	to `PicRankOneNativePresentation`, whose converted module is definitionally the native module.
    21	
    22	This is the O-linear zero-locus seam needed before the datum-side local equations can be shown to
    23	cut out the intrinsic evaluation divisor.  It does not assert regularity, construct a family-level
    24	divisor, or manufacture the still-missing arbitrary-affine presentation producer.
    25	-/
    26	
    27	set_option autoImplicit false
    28	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    29	
    30	universe u
    31	
    32	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    33	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    34	
    35	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    36	
    37	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    38	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    39	
    40	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    41	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    42	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    43	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    44	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    45	variable {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    46	
    47	namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    48	
    49	/-- Transport through the tied sheaf isomorphism commutes with restriction on sections. -/
    50	theorem module_iso_inv_restrict
    51	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    52	    {U V : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
    53	    (s : P.datum.sheaf.obj.obj (op U)) :
    54	    (((Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
    55	      (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)))
    56	        P.module).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
    57	      ((P.module_iso.inv.hom.app (op U)).hom s)) =
    58	      (P.module_iso.inv.hom.app (op V)).hom
    59	        ((P.datum.sheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom s) := by
    60	  exact congrArg (fun z => z.hom s)
    61	    (P.module_iso.inv.hom.naturality (homOfLE h).op).symm
    62	
    63	/-- Restriction vanishes after transport to the module exactly when the datum restriction
    64	vanishes.  This is the pointwise zero-locus comparison supplied by `module_iso`; it needs no
    65	Noetherian hypothesis. -/
    66	theorem module_iso_inv_restrict_eq_zero_iff
    67	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    68	    {U V : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
    69	    (s : P.datum.sheaf.obj.obj (op U)) :
    70	    (((Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
    71	      (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)))
    72	        P.module).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
    73	      ((P.module_iso.inv.hom.app (op U)).hom s) = 0) ↔
    74	      ((P.datum.sheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom s = 0) := by
    75	  rw [P.module_iso_inv_restrict h s]
    76	  exact map_eq_zero_iff _
    77	    (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
    78	      (P.module_iso.inv.hom.app (op V))).1
    79	
    80	/-- The evaluation counit sends the canonical H⁰ unit-lift to the module section obtained
    81	from the tied datum class. -/
    82	theorem evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0_eq_moduleSectionsEquiv
    83	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    84	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
    85	    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
    86	      ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
    87	        (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
    88	      (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.moduleSectionsEquiv y := by
    89	  calc
    90	    _ = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := P.evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0 y
    91	    _ = P.moduleSectionsEquiv y := rfl
    92	
    93	/-- The canonical evaluation section and the tied datum section have the same restriction-
    94	vanishing predicate on every open of the relative curve.
    95	
    96	This is the immediate consumer of `module_iso_inv_restrict_eq_zero_iff`: the evaluated section
    97	is first identified with `moduleSectionsEquiv y`, then with the inverse image of
    98	`datumSection y` under the presentation's sheaf isomorphism. -/
    99	theorem evaluationLift_restrict_eq_zero_iff
   100	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   101	    {V : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens} (h : V ≤ ⊤)
   102	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   103	    (((Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   104	      (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)))
   105	        P.module).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   106	      ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
   107	        ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   108	          (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   109	        (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y)) = 0) ↔
   110	      ((P.datum.sheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   111	        (P.datumSection y) = 0) := by
   112	  rw [P.evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0_eq_moduleSectionsEquiv y]
   113	  rw [← P.module_iso_inv_datumSection y]
   114	  exact P.module_iso_inv_restrict_eq_zero_iff h (P.datumSection y)
   115	
   116	end PicRankOneLocalPresentation
   117	
   118	namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation
   119	
   120	/-- Native specialization of the evaluation/datum zero-locus comparison.
   121	
   122	`toLocalPresentation.module` is definitionally `P.datum.nativeModule`, so this theorem is the
   123	consumer-facing native O-linear seam rather than a second choice of line bundle. -/
   124	theorem evaluationLift_restrict_eq_zero_iff
   125	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam)
   126	    {V : (relCurve C P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier).Opens} (h : V ≤ ⊤)
   127	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.toLocalPresentation.datum.sheaf 0) :
   128	    (((Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   129	      (Over.mk (relCurve C P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier ↘
   130	        Spec (.of P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier)))
   131	        P.toLocalPresentation.module).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   132	      ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.toLocalPresentation.evaluation
   133	        ((relCurve C P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier ↘
   134	          Spec (.of P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   135	          (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   136	        (P.toLocalPresentation.evaluationLiftOfH0 y)) = 0) ↔
   137	      ((P.toLocalPresentation.datum.sheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   138	        (P.toLocalPresentation.datumSection y) = 0) := by
   139	  exact P.toLocalPresentation.evaluationLift_restrict_eq_zero_iff h y
   140	
   141	end PicRankOneNativePresentation
   142	
   143	end AlgebraicGeometry

   424	/-- Nonvanishing on every residue-field fibre of `D(f)` survives passage from the
   425	corresponding prime of the original ring to the residue field of a prime of `A_f`.
   426	
   427	The residue-field comparison is an isomorphism because localization induces bijective
   428	residue-field maps.  Keeping this as a private module lemma prevents the rank-one
   429	construction from depending on a false definitional transitivity of datum base change. -/
   430	private theorem fibre_tmul_ne_zero_of_away
   431	    {A Q : Type u} [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup Q] [Module A Q]
   432	    (f : A) (y : Q)
   433	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   434	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   435	        Q ⊗[A] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   436	    (q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away f)) :
   437	    ((1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
   438	      q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
   439	  let p : PrimeSpectrum A :=
   440	    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) q
   441	  have hfp : f ∉ p.asIdeal := by
   442	    intro hf
   443	    refine q.isPrime.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem q.asIdeal
   444	      (Ideal.mem_comap.mp hf) ?_)
   445	    exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit f
   446	  have hp : ((1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
   447	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
   448	    have h := (TensorProduct.comm A Q p.asIdeal.ResidueField).map_ne_zero_iff.mpr
   449	      (hy p hfp)
   450	    simpa only [TensorProduct.comm_tmul] using h
   451	  have hcom : p.asIdeal =
   452	      q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) := rfl
   453	  let rho : p.asIdeal.ResidueField →ₐ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   454	    Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ p.asIdeal q.asIdeal
   455	      (Algebra.ofId A (Localization.Away f)) hcom
   456	  have hrho : Function.Bijective rho :=
   457	    (RingHom.surjectiveOnStalks_of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers f)
   458	      (Localization.Away f)).residueFieldMap_bijective
   459	        p.asIdeal q.asIdeal hcom
   460	  let e : p.asIdeal.ResidueField ≃ₗ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   461	    LinearEquiv.ofBijective rho.toLinearMap hrho
   462	  have he := (e.rTensor Q).map_ne_zero_iff.mpr hp
   463	  simpa only [LinearEquiv.rTensor_tmul, e, LinearEquiv.ofBijective_apply,
   464	    AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, map_one] using he

    16	/-!
    17	# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus
    18	
    19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
    20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
    21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
    22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
    23	
    24	* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
    25	* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
    26	* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
    27	* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
    28	* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
    29	
    30	No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
    31	consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
    32	The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
    33	from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
    34	datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that
    35	the evaluation counit sends the canonical unit-lift back to that same section.
    36	-/

    59	/-- A rank-one presentation of a genus-degree plus class on an affine test.
    60	
    61	The two equality fields prevent an unrelated cocycle datum or line bundle from serving as a
    62	witness: `representative` presents the input plus class, `datum_class` presents that same
    63	relative Picard class, and `module_iso` identifies the resulting cocycle sheaf with the
    64	underlying base-ring sheaf of `module`. -/
    65	structure PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    66	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    67	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A

    74	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass

   127	/-- The canonical native pushforward base-change isomorphism supplied by the presentation.

   129	The isomorphism is not chosen independently: its hom is definitionally

   131	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   132	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   133	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   134	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   135	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'

   137	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
   138	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   139	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   140	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) := by

   146	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   147	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   148	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   149	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier B)))).obj
   150	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   151	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   152	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   153	        (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))).obj

   157	    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left

   163	noncomputable def evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   164	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   165	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   166	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   167	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   168	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   169	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   170	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⋙
   171	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj
   172	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   173	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   174	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback f').obj
   175	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) :=
   176	  ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   177	    Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   178	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   179	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).app
   180	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   181	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)).symm) ≪≫
   182	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').mapIso (P.nativeBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq)

   184	/-- Under the source identification, evaluation after base change is the pullback of the
   185	presentation's original evaluation counit. -/
   186	theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation
   187	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   188	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   189	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   190	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   191	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   192	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   193	    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq).hom ≫
   194	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   195	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) =
   196	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map P.evaluation := by
   197	  change ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   198	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   199	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   200	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).inv).app
   201	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   202	            (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)) ≫
   203	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module) ≫
   204	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   205	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module)) =
   206	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
   207	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   208	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module)
   209	  exact canonicalBaseChangeMap_counit_cancel sq P.module

    12	# The consumed local divisor package for the rank-one route
    13	
    14	This module is the first divisor consumer of PicRankOneLocalPresentation.  The projective
    15	rank-one H0 module supplies a basic open and a section which is nonzero on every residue fibre
    16	there.  The datum-side section construction then gives regular local equations, and the widened
    17	effectivity engine packages those equations as a DivFamZarAff of degree genus C.

    20	family-level divisorOfRankOne, identify the equations with the native zero locus, or assert
    21	that the rank-one locus is represented by an open subscheme.  Those remain the next contracts.

    78	/-! ## Regularity and degree of the local equations -/
    79	
    80	/-- The local equations cut from the tied datum section remain regular after every field-valued
    81	coefficient extension.  This is the regularity input consumed by the widened effectivity
    82	engine, derived from the same fibrewise nonvanishing hypothesis used in the construction. -/
    83	theorem baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_fibrewiseRegular
    84	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    85	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    86	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
    87	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    88	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
    89	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    90	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    91	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
    92	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    93	    [Algebra (Localization.Away f) L]
    94	    [IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away f) L]
    95	    (z : relCurve C L) :
    96	    ((relCurve C L).presheaf.germ
    97	      (((P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).cover.pullback
    98	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)).opens z) z
    99	      (((P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).cover.pullback
   100	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)).mem_opens z)).hom
   101	      (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn
   102	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)
   103	        (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy) z) ∈
   104	      nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C L).presheaf.stalk z) := by
   105	  let B := Localization.Away f
   106	  let D := P.datum.baseChange B
   107	  let s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤) :=
   108	    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y
   109	  have hsec : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
   110	      D.sectionsMapTop q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   111	        (P.datumSectionBaseChange B y) ≠ 0 :=
   112	    fun q => P.sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero f y hy q
   113	  have hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (q : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
   114	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   115	    fun j q => D.injective_rTensor_component_of_sectionsMapTop_ne_zero
   116	      s q (hsec q) j
   117	  unfold baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange
   118	  exact D.germ_self_pullbackEqn_sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular
   119	    s hfib L z

   121	/-- The local equations have the genus class degree after every field-valued extension.  The
   122	calculation uses the datum class law and datum_classDeg_baseChange, so the degree is tied to
   123	the presentation rather than supplied as an unrelated witness. -/
   124	theorem baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_classDeg
   125	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   126	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   127	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   128	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   129	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   130	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   131	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   132	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   133	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   134	    [Algebra (Localization.Away f) L]
   135	    [IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away f) L] :
   136	    classDeg L
   137	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)
   138	        (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).picClass) = genus C := by
   139	  letI : Algebra P.cover.Carrier L :=
   140	    ((algebraMap (Localization.Away f) L).comp
   141	      (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f))).toAlgebra
   142	  haveI : IsScalarTower P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f) L :=
   143	    ⟨fun r s x => by
   144	      rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul (Localization.Away f) r s]
   145	      simp only [Algebra.smul_def, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, RingHom.comp_apply,
   146	        RingHom.id_apply, map_mul, mul_assoc]⟩
   147	  haveI : IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L :=
   148	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (R := k) (S := P.cover.Carrier) (A := L) (by
   149	      ext a
   150	      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
   151	      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k (Localization.Away f) L,
   152	        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f)] <;>
   153	        rfl)
   154	  rw [P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_picClass f y hy,
   155	    P.datum.cechPicClass_baseChange (Localization.Away f),
   156	    ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp,
   157	    relCurveMap_comp]
   158	  exact P.datum_classDeg_baseChange L

   162	/- The next canonicality edge is expressed first in the localized H⁰ module.  The datum
   163	   section/native comparison needed to transport this unit to local equations is deliberately
   164	   a separate contract. -/
   165	theorem existsUnique_unit_tensorAway_rankOne_generators
   166	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   167	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   168	    (y y' : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   169	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   170	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   171	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   172	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   173	    (hy' : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   174	      (y' ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   175	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   176	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   177	    ∃! v : (Localization.Away f)ˣ,
   178	      ((1 : Localization.Away f) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y') =
   179	        (v : Localization.Away f) •
   180	          ((1 : Localization.Away f) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y) := by
